title: Entitled Veteran Thinks Laws Don't Apply To Him
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On November 14th, 2023. An officer was called to the airport regarding a man who refused to pay for his tab at a bar. When speaking to the manager he said that he refused to pay because he's a veteran, the officer then spoke to the man and he started to get hostile after refusing to listen to the officer's commands. After trying to explain to him that he did not pay for his tab, he tried to say that he paid with his credit, but did not have a receipt or anything to prove his claim. He also stated that he's an ex-marine and kept asking "have you ever been to war?".  The man eventually realized he did not pay for the tab and apologized for causing a scene, he then agreed to pay for it. However, when walking to the bar, he started to get confrontational again with the officer and kept asking if they'd ever been to war, eventually leading to the officers taking him down. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
